verdict.rationale: Helicone's Sessions feature groups related requests so you can trace an entire agent flow, from user input to final response, in one unified view. Path syntax expresses parent-child relationships, which gives a nested hierarchy, and the GitHub README confirms sessions and traces are viewable in the UI. Missing for 10: evidence that non-LLM steps (tool calls, custom spans) can be captured as true spans rather than only LLM requests, any thread-level grouping, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sessions feature specifically.
